app.name: Private Delphi
app.tagline: Expert consensus where nobody can read anyone else's answers
lang.label: Language
home.title: Ask experts. Keep every answer private.
home.lead: Experts rate each criterion. Their answers are locked on their own device before they leave. The group result is opened only when 2 of 3 key holders agree.
home.step1.title: You answer
home.step1.body: Pick a level from Very low to Very high for each criterion.
home.step2.title: It's locked on your device
home.step2.body: Your answers are scrambled before they're sent. The organizer only ever sees scrambled data.
home.step3.title: Only the total is opened
home.step3.body: 2 of 3 key holders must agree to open the group result. Nobody can open a single person's answers.
home.step4.title: Anyone can check
home.step4.body: Every locked ballot and every calculation is public. Anyone can rerun them and compare.
home.roles.title: Who does what
home.role.expert.body: Answers the questions. Gets a receipt code.
home.role.organizer.body: Sets up the survey and invites experts. Can't read answers.
home.role.keyholder.body: Holds one of 3 keys. Any 2 together can open the group result.
home.role.auditor.body: Anyone. Reruns the public calculation to confirm nothing was changed.
home.note: Proof of concept. Not yet reviewed by independent cryptographers.
vote.title: Your ballot
vote.question: How important is this, in your view?
vote.lock.note: Your answers are locked on this device before they leave. Nobody can read your individual answers, not even the organizer.
vote.review.title: Check your answers
vote.locking: Locking your answers on this device…
vote.sent.title: Ballot sent
vote.sent.body: Keep this receipt code. Look it up on the public board to confirm your ballot was counted.
vote.err.missing: Pick a level for every criterion first. Missing: {list}.
vote.err.crypto: This browser couldn't lock your ballot. Try a recent Chrome, Edge, Firefox, or Safari.
vote.err.send: Your ballot couldn't be sent. Check your connection and try again.
vote.demo: Demo mode: nothing is sent and no real encryption happens yet.
results.title: Round {round} results
results.legend: The line marks the keep threshold (0.5). A criterion is kept when its score reaches the line. The group agrees when at least 75% of experts are close to the group view.
results.range: Group view: from {low} to {high}, most likely {mid}
results.check.body: Download the public board and rerun the calculation. If your numbers match these, nothing was changed.
results.empty: Results aren't open yet. They appear here once 2 of 3 key holders open them.
how.title: How your privacy is protected
how.lock.title: Locking
how.lock.body: Your browser turns your answers into scrambled numbers using a public lock. Only the key holders' keys, used together, can unscramble anything.
how.math.title: Math on locked data
how.math.body: The server adds up the locked ballots without unlocking them. It never sees a single answer.
how.check.title: Catching bad ballots
how.check.body: Each locked ballot is tested to confirm it picks exactly one level per criterion. A broken or cheating ballot is dropped without revealing what's inside.
how.open.title: Opening only the total
how.open.body: Key holders open only the group totals. They never receive individual ballots.
how.limits.title: What it doesn't protect against
how.limits.body: If 2 key holders work together dishonestly, they could open individual ballots. Choose key holders who are independent of each other.
org.title: Set up a survey
org.lead: Write your criteria, choose how many experts to invite, and get the links to send out.
org.adminkey.help: The secret set when this site was deployed. It lets you create surveys.
org.criteria.help: Write English | Tiếng Việt on each line. One language is fine too.
org.criteria.placeholder: Well-trained teachers | Giáo viên được đào tạo bài bản
org.links.title: Your links
org.links.warn: Save these links now. They can't be shown again, and anyone with a link can act in that role.
org.links.holders: Key holder links: send one to each of the 3 key holders
org.links.experts: Expert invitations: send one to each expert
org.dash.title: Survey status
org.close.confirm: Close voting now? Experts who haven't voted won't be able to.
org.auto: The server steps run automatically every 10 minutes.
kh.title: Key holder
kh.lead: You hold 1 of 3 keys. Any 2 key holders together can open the group results. Nobody can open a single expert's answers.
kh.step.create.body: Your browser makes your key. It never leaves this device unless you save it.
kh.step.save.body: Choose a passphrase you won't forget. You'll need this file and passphrase to open results.
kh.step.backup: Back up your key to the other key holders
kh.step.backup.body: Your key is split into 3 pieces, each locked for one key holder. Any 2 pieces can rebuild it if you're unavailable later.
kh.step.finish.body: One last step once all 3 key holders have created their keys.
kh.waiting.prev: Waiting for key holder {n} to create their key.
kh.waiting.contacts: Waiting for every key holder to open their link.
kh.waiting.last: Waiting for key holder 3 to create their key.
kh.done.setup: Setup complete. You'll be needed again when voting closes.
kh.err.pass: Use at least 10 characters, and type the same passphrase twice.
kh.err.wrongpass: That passphrase doesn't open this key file.
kh.open.title: Open the results
kh.open.body: Load your key file. Your browser opens only the group totals and sends that partial result back.
kh.open.done: Your part is done. Results appear once 2 key holders have finished and the server combines them.
kh.open.notyet: Nothing to open yet. Come back when the organizer closes voting.
kh.absent.title: A key holder is unavailable?
kh.absent.body: Two key holders can stand in for the third. One sends their backup piece, the other rebuilds the missing key and opens its part.
kh.absent.role.send: I send my backup piece to key holder {n}
kh.absent.role.rebuild: I rebuild the missing key (key holder {n} sends their piece)
kh.absent.waiting: Waiting for key holder {n} to send their piece.
kh.err.token: This link isn't valid. Ask the organizer for your key holder link.
kh.status.closed: Voting closed: the server is preparing the totals
kh.status.opening: Results are ready to be opened
vote.err.link: This invitation link isn't valid. Ask the organizer for a new one.
vote.err.used: This invitation has already been used in this round.
vote.loading: Preparing the lock on this device…
results.pending: Results for this round aren't published yet.
